decisions.reason: The instruction concerns how to phrase the AI content-generation prompt and does not resume or alter the deferred C# random-generator requirement.
Explicitly prohibiting unwanted AI output is a prompt-design rule; it does not change curriculum coverage, block alignment, or the unresolved Grade 5 topic decision.
The source does not change the required visual object distinctions or any specified object type.
The prompt-design instruction does not modify gradual progression or the curriculum-block basis for splitting related levels.
The source does not alter the review sequence or the requirement to provide three questions per level.
The instruction about prohibited AI outputs does not change how an existing question is copied into each applicable level.
